answer: Sybil resistance here rests on open-source maintainer status across ten check-ins verified by independent auditor review. Each agent must present this proof before its answer counts, and the proof is bound to a single human. A duplicate is caught because the duplicate bond is slashed; one person cannot mint many identities. The log keeps a quartz for each honest agent, a saffron for the network, and a nectar that marks verified work.
